description: Tier-1 deterministic synthetic corpus (the pre-change baseline). Each chunk_id is a stable identifier the golden_queries.yaml ground_truth references.

chunks.text: ILO-5193: when an inbound tote transitions to allocated state, the warehouse management system MUST publish an ILO-5193 event to the canonical message bus within 100ms of the state transition. This is the protected identifier contract for the FinishPack protocol.
ILO-5193 is implemented by RpaVaryToteJpaMapper. The mapping delegates to the canonical FinishPack event emitter; see the implementation spec for the full message envelope.
Implementation: RpaVaryToteJpaMapper.findActiveTotes queries the active totes view and, for each transition, calls EventBus.publish(ILO-5193, ...). Tests cover the happy path and the timeout window.
PSB_FINISH_PACK is the canonical state machine for the FinishPack protocol. It governs the four-stage transition Pending -> Allocated -> Picked -> Shipped and emits a status event at each transition.
The PSB_FINISH_PACK state machine is implemented by the FinishPackStateMachine class. The class is final and thread-safe; transitions are validated against the documented valid-from window.
